definition.description: The absolute number of lymphocytes per microliter of blood.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the absolute lymphocyte count (ALC) from the pretreatment complete blood count (CBC) or laboratory report.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the absolute lymphocyte count is not provided, represent as null.
definition.name: absolute_lymphocyte_count

definition.description: Presence of molecular alterations in a patient that are actionable for targeted therapy.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient's molecular or genetic testing results indicate the presence of any alterations classified as clinically actionable.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no molecular testing results are documented or if the actionability of identified mutations is not specified.
definition.name: actionable_molecular_alterations

definition.description: Whether the patient received adjuvant chemotherapy following primary treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if adjuvant chemotherapy was administered by searching for explicit mentions of 'adjuvant chemotherapy' or specific chemotherapy regimens (e.g., 'pemetrexed 4 cycles') documented as being given in the adjuvant setting.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the patient record contains no information regarding the administration of adjuvant chemotherapy.
definition.name: adjuvant_chemotherapy_administered

definition.description: The presence of metastatic disease in the adrenal glands.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if the pretreatment clinical record (specifically radiology reports such as CT or PET/CT, or oncology progress notes) indicates the presence of metastatic lesions in the adrenal glands. This includes explicit mentions of 'adrenal metastasis', 'metastatic involvement' of the adrenal glands, or radiographic findings described as 'consistent with' or 'suspicious for' metastasis in the adrenal glands.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the adrenal glands are not mentioned or if the documentation is too ambiguous to determine presence or absence.
definition.name: adrenal_metastasis_presence

definition.description: The maximum diameter of an adrenal nodule.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value of the largest adrenal nodule size reported in imaging (e.g., CT), typically measured in centimeters.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no adrenal nodule is documented or if the size is not specified.
definition.name: adrenal_nodule_size

definition.description: The age of the patient at the time of the clinical encounter or index date.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the patient's age in years from the demographic section, pathology reports, or clinical narratives (e.g., '86-year-old', 'age 45').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if age is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: age

definition.description: Presence of pathological involvement of the airway.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient record or imaging reports indicate that the airway (specifically the central airway) is involved by a disease process.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the record does not mention airway involvement or is ambiguous.
definition.name: airway_involvement

definition.description: The average quantity of alcoholic beverages consumed by the patient per week.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the number of alcoholic drinks consumed per week. For ranges (e.g., '1-2 drinks/week'), calculate the mean. For reports of 'no alcohol use' or 'denies alcohol', extract as 0. If described as 'occasional' without a specific number, extract the numeric value if provided in the same context (e.g., 'occasional wine, <= 2 drinks/week' = 2).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if alcohol use is not mentioned, not documented, or is too ambiguous to assign a numeric value.
definition.name: alcohol_use

definition.description: ALK mutation or rearrangement status
definition.measurement_definition: The result of ALK mutation or rearrangement testing from the pretreatment record, identifying whether the gene is wild-type (negative) or mutated/rearranged (positive).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if ALK testing was not performed or the result is not documented.
definition.name: alk_mutation_status

definition.description: The patient's serum alkaline phosphatase level.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value of alkaline phosphatase (ALP) reported in laboratory results, typically as part of a Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP).
definition.missing_value_rule: If the alkaline phosphatase level is not documented or is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: alkaline_phosphatase_level

definition.description: Whether the patient is using anticoagulant medication.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient is documented as using anticoagulant medications in the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if anticoagulant use is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: anticoagulant_use

definition.description: Patient use of antihypertensive medications.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient is documented as taking antihypertensive medication from the pretreatment medical records, medication lists, or clinical history.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if antihypertensive medication use is not mentioned or is ambiguous.
definition.name: antihypertensive_use

definition.description: Presence of anxiety symptoms or a diagnosis of anxiety during the pretreatment period.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient record mentions the presence of anxiety in the psychiatric or psychosocial sections, or within the history of present illness. Any mention of anxiety, regardless of severity (e.g., 'mild anxiety', 'occasional anxiety'), is extracted as 'Present'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Absent' if there is no mention of anxiety in the provided clinical documentation.
definition.name: anxiety_present

definition.description: Whether the patient has a history of appendectomy.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether an appendectomy is documented in the patient's past surgical history or medical records.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'No' if not documented or explicitly denied.
definition.name: appendectomy_history

definition.description: The patient's reported or clinician-observed appetite status.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the appetite status from the clinical record. Map terms such as 'normal', 'stable', or 'resumed normal oral intake' to 'Normal'. Map terms such as 'decreased', 'loss of appetite', 'slightly decreased', or any reported severity/score for appetite loss (e.g., PRO-CTCAE or EORTC QLQ-C30 appetite loss scores > 0) to 'Decreased'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if appetite status is not documented.
definition.name: appetite_status

definition.description: The patient's aspartate aminotransferase (AST) level.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value for AST (aspartate aminotransferase) from the pretreatment comprehensive metabolic panel (CMP) or liver function tests.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the AST level is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: ast_level

definition.description: Presence of an abnormality in the axial structures.
definition.measurement_definition: Review clinical records for any mention of axial structure abnormalities. Extract 'Present' if an abnormality is documented; extract 'Absent' if the records explicitly state no abnormality or that axial structures are normal.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if axial structures are not mentioned or if the documentation is too ambiguous to determine presence or absence.
definition.name: axial_structure_abnormality

definition.description: Patient's glomerular filtration rate measurement.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value of the glomerular filtration rate (GFR) reported in ml/min from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent missing or ambiguous GFR documentation as null.
definition.name: biomarker_fgfr_status

definition.description: The technique or procedure used to obtain the tissue biopsy specimen.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the specific method used to obtain the biopsy specimen (e.g., bronchoscopic, needle biopsy) from the procedure or pathology documentation.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no biopsy method is documented.
definition.name: biopsy_method

definition.description: The patient's blood pressure, specifically the systolic value.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the blood pressure measurement from the pretreatment record. When blood pressure is recorded as a systolic/diastolic pair (e.g., 128/78 mmHg), extract the systolic (first) value. If only a single numeric value is provided for blood pressure, extract that value.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if blood pressure is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: blood_pressure

definition.description: A measurement of the amount of nitrogen in the blood that comes from the urea produced by the liver, used primarily to assess renal function.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value of blood urea nitrogen (BUN) from the comprehensive metabolic panel (CMP) or specific renal function laboratory tests.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the value is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: blood_urea_nitrogen

definition.description: The patient's body mass index (BMI), a measure of body fat based on height and weight.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value for BMI in kg/m² from the pretreatment record, typically located in the vital signs or physical examination sections.
definition.missing_value_rule: If BMI is not documented and cannot be calculated from height and weight, the value is null.
definition.name: bmi

definition.description: The patient's body weight recorded prior to the start of treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value of the patient's body weight in kilograms (kg). If the value is reported in pounds (lbs), convert it to kilograms.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if body weight is not documented or cannot be reliably extracted.
definition.name: body_weight

definition.description: The morphological characteristic of bone lesions identified in the patient record.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the described type of bone lesion morphology (e.g., lytic, blastic, or mixed) from the musculoskeletal or oncology sections of the clinical record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no specific morphology is documented.
definition.name: bone_lesion_characteristics

definition.description: Presence of bone metastasis at the time of pretreatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if there is any documentation of bone or osseous metastasis in the pretreatment record, typically extracted from radiology reports (e.g., bone scan, PET/CT, CT, MRI) or oncology assessment notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if bone metastasis is not mentioned or the documentation is too ambiguous to determine presence or absence.
definition.name: bone_metastasis_presence

definition.description: The anatomical location of the patient's reported or observed bone pain.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the anatomical region of the skeleton associated with reported bone pain, tenderness during physical examination, or documented symptomatic bone metastases (e.g., 'T8' or 'thoracic spine' maps to 'Thoracic spine'; 'L3', 'low back', or 'lumbar spine' maps to 'Lumbar spine'; 'femur' maps to 'Femur').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no bone pain location is documented or if bone pain is mentioned without a specified location.
definition.name: bone_pain_location

definition.description: Presence of bone pain during the pretreatment period.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether bone pain is documented in the pretreatment records. This includes explicit mentions of 'bone pain', 'bone discomfort', or 'back pain' when it is associated with osseous metastases (e.g., 'thoracic bone pain', 'lower-back pain radiating to the left flank', or 'right femoral pain').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if bone pain is neither documented as present nor explicitly denied in the record.
definition.name: bone_pain_status

definition.description: The presence or absence of brain edema.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the status of cerebral edema from radiology reports (e.g., MRI T2 FLAIR) or neurological clinical evaluations.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if brain edema is not documented or the status is ambiguous.
definition.name: brain_edema_status

definition.description: Total number of discrete lesions identified within the brain parenchyma.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the total number of distinct, discrete intracranial lesions (such as enhancing nodules, masses, or FDG-avid foci) reported in the neuroimaging findings. If the report explicitly states 'no lesions' or 'no abnormal uptake', the value is 0.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no brain imaging is documented or if the report does not specify the number of lesions.
definition.name: brain_lesion_count

definition.description: The maximum diameter of the largest brain lesion.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the largest dimension in centimeters of the largest brain lesion identified on brain MRI. If only one dimension is provided, use that value. If multiple dimensions are provided for a single lesion, extract the maximum of those values.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no brain lesions are identified, if brain imaging was not performed, or if the size of the lesion is not specified.
definition.name: brain_lesion_size

definition.description: Presence of brain metastases
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether brain metastases (intracranial lesions) are present or absent based on radiographic evidence (e.g., brain MRI, CT) or clinical documentation in the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the record contains no information, explicitly states the status is unknown or uncertain, or if imaging was inconclusive due to technical limitations.
definition.name: brain_metastases_presence

definition.description: Presence of abnormal contrast enhancement in brain structures.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient record reports 'abnormal enhancement' or 'contrast enhancement' within brain structures (e.g., brainstem, cerebellum, or ventricles).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no mention of abnormal enhancement or if the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: brain_structure_enhancement

definition.description: Assessment of the radiologic signal intensity of the brainstem on MRI.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the reported signal appearance of the brainstem from neuroimaging reports; 'normal', 'unremarkable', or 'no abnormal signal' should be mapped to Normal, while any mention of abnormal signal intensity, lesions, or pathology within the brainstem should be mapped to Abnormal.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the brainstem signal is not explicitly mentioned or if the documentation is too ambiguous to categorize.
definition.name: brainstem_signal

definition.description: Qualitative assessment of the brainstem size based on neuroimaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the reported size of the brainstem from neuroimaging (e.g., MRI, CT). If the report states the brainstem is 'normal in size', 'unremarkable', or 'within normal limits', record as 'Normal'. If the report indicates atrophy, enlargement, or any other size-related abnormality, record as 'Abnormal'.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the brainstem size is not mentioned or cannot be determined from the text, return null.
definition.name: brainstem_size

definition.description: The total daily energy intake of the patient described qualitatively.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the qualitative descriptor of the total daily caloric intake, such as 'low', 'adequate', or 'high'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent missing or ambiguous documentation as null.
definition.name: calorie_intake

definition.description: Presence of lytic or sclerotic lesions in the calvarium.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether lytic or sclerotic lesions are reported to be present or absent in the calvarium (skull) from imaging reports.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the calvarium is not mentioned or if the report is ambiguous regarding the presence of these lesions.
definition.name: calvarium_lytic_sclerotic_lesions

definition.description: The severity of cancer-related fatigue as measured by the PRO-CTCAE (Patient-Reported Outcomes Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events) scale.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric PRO-CTCAE grade for fatigue, typically represented as an integer from 0 (none) to 4 (very severe).
definition.missing_value_rule: If no PRO-CTCAE fatigue grade is explicitly documented, the value should be represented as null.
definition.name: cancer_related_fatigue_severity

definition.description: Whether carboplatin was administered to the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract 'Yes' if the patient record contains any evidence of carboplatin administration, prescription, or mention in a treatment regimen; otherwise, extract 'No'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Absent or ambiguous documentation is represented as 'No'.
definition.name: carboplatin_administered

definition.description: The mutation status of the CDKN2A gene, specifically whether a homozygous deletion or loss is present in the tumor tissue.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the CDKN2A status from Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) or molecular profiling reports. Identify 'homozygous deletion', 'homozygous loss', or 'loss' as the mutation status. If the gene is listed as not mutated, not altered, or is absent from the genomic findings table while other genes are listed, it should be extracted as 'wild-type'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if molecular testing for CDKN2A was not performed or is not documented in the patient record.
definition.name: cdkn2a_mutation_status

definition.description: Blood concentration of Carcinoembryonic Antigen (CEA), a tumor marker used for monitoring non-small cell lung cancer.
definition.measurement_definition: The numeric value of the CEA level extracted from laboratory tumor marker results in the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the CEA level is not documented or the value is ambiguous.
definition.name: cea_level

definition.description: The total number of chemotherapy cycles administered to the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical count of chemotherapy cycles mentioned in the record (e.g., '4 cycles' or 'four cycles').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the number of cycles is not documented or cannot be determined from the text.
definition.name: chemotherapy_cycle_count

definition.description: The specific chemotherapy agent or combination of agents administered to the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the name of the chemotherapy drug or the specific combination of drugs (e.g., 'Cisplatin + Pemetrexed', 'Pemetrexed', 'Taxane-based') identified in the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent missing or ambiguous documentation as 'Unknown'.
definition.name: chemotherapy_regimen

definition.description: The documented stage of chronic kidney disease (CKD).
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the explicitly stated stage of chronic kidney disease (CKD), typically reported as a number from 1 to 5 (e.g., 'CKD stage 3').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the CKD stage is not explicitly documented.
definition.name: chronic_kidney_disease_stage

definition.description: Presence or absence of Cytokeratin 5/6 (CK5/6) expression in tumor cells as determined by immunohistochemistry.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the result of the Cytokeratin 5/6 (CK5/6) immunohistochemistry (IHC) stain from the pathology report. Interpret descriptions of positivity (e.g., 'Positive', 'focal positivity', 'diffuse cytoplasmic positivity', 'CK5/6+') as 'Positive' and descriptions of negativity (e.g., 'Negative', 'CK5/6-') as 'Negative'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the CK5/6 stain was not performed, the result is not reported, or the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: ck5_6_expression

definition.description: The immunohistochemical expression status of Cytokeratin 7 (CK7) in tumor tissue.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the immunohistochemistry (IHC) result for CK7 (Cytokeratin 7) from the pathology report. This is typically listed in an immunophenotype table or the diagnostic summary as 'Positive', 'Negative', or indicated by symbols like 'CK7+' or 'CK7-'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if CK7 expression is not documented or the result is ambiguous.
definition.name: ck7_expression

definition.description: Indicator of whether the patient has experienced a general clinical decline prior to the start of treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient record explicitly mentions that the patient has declined or experienced clinical deterioration.
definition.missing_value_rule: If there is no documentation regarding clinical decline or stability, the value is null.
definition.name: clinical_decline

definition.description: The patient's clinical phenotype classification.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the documented clinical phenotype classification from the pretreatment record, specifically identifying categories such as intermediate, mild, or severe.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the clinical phenotype is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: clinical_phenotype

definition.description: A numerical clinical severity score on a scale from 0 to 4.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value of the clinical severity score (e.g., extract '2' from '2/4' or 'severity 2').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent missing or ambiguous documentation as null.
definition.name: clinical_severity_score

definition.description: The total number of distinct comorbid medical conditions documented in the patient's pretreatment record.
definition.measurement_definition: Count the number of unique diagnosed medical conditions present in the patient record, excluding the primary diagnosis for which the patient is being treated.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 0 if no comorbidities are documented; represent as null if the record is missing or unable to be parsed.
definition.name: comorbidities

definition.description: The overall clinical interpretation of the patient's complete blood count (CBC) result.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the qualitative interpretation (e.g., normal or abnormal) of the complete blood count panel from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no CBC result or interpretation is documented.
definition.name: complete_blood_count_result

definition.description: Presence of confusion as a clinical symptom.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if confusion is documented as a symptom in the patient's clinical record, such as in the chief complaint or history of present illness.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'absent' if not mentioned or explicitly denied in the record.
definition.name: confusion_present

definition.description: The concentration of the iodinated contrast agent used during imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value of the iodine concentration of the contrast agent from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the concentration is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: contrast_agent_concentration

definition.description: The presence of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) prior to the start of treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify whether the patient has a documented diagnosis of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) within the past medical history, problem list, or clinical assessment sections of the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no mention of COPD or if the documentation is too ambiguous to determine presence or absence.
definition.name: copd_presence

definition.description: The severity level of the patient's chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the clinician-reported severity grade for COPD (e.g., 'mild', 'moderate', 'severe', or 'very severe') from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no specific severity grade is documented.
definition.name: copd_severity

definition.description: Presence of coronary artery disease
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient has a documented diagnosis of coronary artery disease (CAD) from the pretreatment clinical record.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the diagnosis is not documented or is ambiguous, represent as 'Absent'.
definition.name: coronary_artery_disease

definition.description: Presence of cough at the pretreatment baseline
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether cough is documented as present or absent in the pretreatment record. Documentation of 'dry', 'productive', 'non-productive', 'persistent', or 'intermittent' cough is considered 'present'. Documentation of 'denies cough', 'no cough', or 'absence of cough' is considered 'absent'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if cough status is not mentioned or is ambiguous.
definition.name: cough_presence

definition.description: Whether the patient's cough produces sputum (productive) or is dry (non-productive).
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the description of cough productivity from the pretreatment record; identify if the cough is explicitly described as 'productive' (associated with sputum production) or 'non-productive' (described as 'dry' or 'without sputum').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if cough productivity is not documented or the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: cough_productivity

definition.description: The severity grade of the patient's cough.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric severity grade of the cough from patient-reported outcomes (e.g., PRO-CTCAE) or clinical notes. If the severity is reported as a fraction (e.g., '2/4'), extract the numerator. If reported as a descriptive term, map 'mild' to 1, 'moderate' to 2, 'severe' to 3, and 'life-threatening' or 'disabling' to 4.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the patient's cough is not mentioned or if the severity is not specified.
definition.name: cough_severity

definition.description: The volume of blood plasma cleared of creatinine per unit time, serving as an indicator of renal function.
definition.measurement_definition: The most recent value for creatinine clearance (CrCl) or estimated creatinine clearance (eCrCl) documented in the pretreatment record, typically reported in mL/min.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no specific creatinine clearance value is documented.
definition.name: creatinine_clearance

definition.description: The numeric measurement of serum creatinine, used as a marker of renal function.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value for serum creatinine (often abbreviated as 'Cr') from the pretreatment comprehensive metabolic panel (CMP) or renal function laboratory results.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no numeric value is documented in the pretreatment record.
definition.name: creatinine_level

definition.description: Patient-level assessment of physical deconditioning severity.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the reported severity level of physical deconditioning (e.g., mild, moderate, severe) from the clinical record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if deconditioning is not mentioned or if the severity is not specified.
definition.name: deconditioning

definition.description: The pressure in the systemic arteries during the relaxation phase of the cardiac cycle.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the second numeric value (the lower number) from a blood pressure reading presented in the systolic/diastolic format (e.g., from '128/74 mmHg', extract '74').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the diastolic blood pressure is not recorded or cannot be unambiguously identified.
definition.name: diastolic_blood_pressure

definition.description: Whether the patient has experienced a recurrence of the disease.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the pretreatment clinical record indicates the return of the disease after a period of remission or successful treatment.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the documentation does not explicitly state whether the disease has recurred or if the information is ambiguous.
definition.name: disease_recurrence

definition.description: Presence of dizziness in the patient prior to treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether dizziness is documented as present or absent in the pretreatment clinical record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if dizziness is not mentioned or the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: dizziness_present

definition.description: The openness or patency of the dural venous sinuses, indicating the absence of thrombosis or obstructive filling defects.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the status of dural sinus patency from neuroimaging reports (e.g., MRI with contrast, CT venography). Identify terms such as 'patent' or 'without filling defects' for a patent status, and 'occluded', 'thrombosed', or 'filling defect' for a non-patent status.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if dural sinus patency is not mentioned or cannot be determined from the provided text.
definition.name: dural_sinus_patency

definition.description: The severity of shortness of breath (dyspnea) experienced by the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the severity of dyspnea or shortness of breath. Priority should be given to PRO-CTCAE grades (0: None, 1: Mild, 2: Moderate, 3: Severe, 4: Life-threatening). Descriptive terms in clinical notes (e.g., 'mild', 'moderate', 'severe') should be mapped to the corresponding category. Reports of 'no dyspnea' or 'denies shortness of breath' should be mapped to 'None'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if dyspnea is not documented or if the documentation is too ambiguous to determine a severity level.
definition.name: dyspnea

definition.description: The severity grade of dyspnea (shortness of breath) as reported by the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical severity grade (0-4) for dyspnea or shortness of breath from patient-reported outcome instruments, specifically the PRO-CTCAE scale, where 0 = None, 1 = Mild, 2 = Moderate, 3 = Severe, and 4 = Life-threatening/Disabling.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the dyspnea severity grade is not documented or the PRO-CTCAE assessment is absent.
definition.name: dyspnea_severity

definition.description: Patient functional status measured by the Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) scale.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric ECOG performance status score (typically 0-5) from the pretreatment clinical record, typically found in the physical examination or assessment sections.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the ECOG status is not documented or is described ambiguously (e.g., a range like '0-1').
definition.name: ecog_performance_status

definition.description: The status of the Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor (EGFR) gene regarding activating mutations in tumor tissue.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the EGFR mutation status from molecular pathology, NGS, or PCR reports. Map 'Wild-type', 'Negative', or 'No activating mutation detected' to 'Wild-type'. Map 'Mutant', 'Positive', or the identification of a specific activating mutation (e.g., 'exon 19 deletion', 'L858R', 'p.E746_A750del') to 'Mutant'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the EGFR analysis was not performed, the result is pending, or no documentation is present in the record.
definition.name: egfr_mutation_status

definition.description: Presence of emphysema in the lungs.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether emphysema is documented in the patient's pretreatment records, such as imaging reports or clinical notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: If emphysema is not mentioned or documentation is ambiguous, represent as 'Absent'.
definition.name: emphysema

definition.description: The patient's current employment status at the time of the pretreatment record.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the patient's current employment status from the social history or general demographics section of the record. Identify terms indicating whether the patient is currently working (Employed), has ceased working (Retired), is not currently working and seeking work (Unemployed), is a student (Student), or is unable to work due to disability (Disabled).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if employment status is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: employment_status

definition.description: A patient-reported outcome score measuring cognitive function using the EORTC QLQ-C30 instrument.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value for 'Cognitive Function' reported under the 'EORTC QLQ-C30' instrument from the patient record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent missing, incomplete, or ambiguous documentation as null.
definition.name: eortc_qlq_c30_cognitive_function

definition.description: The patient's self-reported emotional functioning score from the EORTC QLQ-C30 quality of life questionnaire.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric score for 'Emotional Function' (or 'Emotional') from the EORTC QLQ-C30 assessment. If reported as a fraction (e.g., '75/100'), extract the numerator.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no EORTC QLQ-C30 emotional function score is documented.
definition.name: eortc_qlq_c30_emotional_function

definition.description: Patient-reported global health status and quality of life score from the EORTC QLQ-C30 questionnaire.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value reported for 'Global Health' or 'Global Health Status' within the EORTC QLQ-C30 assessment instrument, typically presented as a value out of 100.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the EORTC QLQ-C30 global health score is not documented or is illegible.
definition.name: eortc_qlq_c30_global_health

definition.description: The nausea symptom score from the EORTC QLQ-C30 quality of life questionnaire.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value specifically attributed to 'Nausea' within the EORTC QLQ-C30 instrument assessment, typically reported as a score from 0 to 100.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the EORTC QLQ-C30 Nausea score is not documented in the patient record.
definition.name: eortc_qlq_c30_nausea

definition.description: The patient's reported physical functioning score from the EORTC QLQ-C30 quality of life questionnaire.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric score for the Physical Function domain from the EORTC QLQ-C30 instrument, typically reported as a value out of 100.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the EORTC QLQ-C30 Physical Function score is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: eortc_qlq_c30_physical_function

definition.description: The patient's reported social functioning score from the EORTC QLQ-C30 quality of life questionnaire.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value for the Social Function domain from the EORTC QLQ-C30 assessment, typically reported as a score out of 100.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the social function score is not documented or the reporting is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: eortc_qlq_c30_social_function

definition.description: Presence of epidural hemorrhage
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether epidural hemorrhage is reported as present or absent from the pretreatment clinical record, specifically within radiology reports describing extra-axial structures or intracranial pathology.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if epidural hemorrhage is not mentioned or documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: epidural_hemorrhage

definition.description: Presence of erythema (redness of the skin) in the patient's pretreatment record.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether erythema is explicitly documented as being present or absent in the pretreatment clinical notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: If no mention of erythema is found in the records, the value is represented as null.
definition.name: erythema_presence

definition.description: Presence of inflammation of the esophageal lining.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether esophagitis is documented as present or absent within the pretreatment record, typically from endoscopy reports, physical examination notes, or diagnostic summaries.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no mention of esophagitis or if the documentation is too ambiguous to determine presence or absence.
definition.name: esophagitis

definition.description: A patient-level scalar measurement of the estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR), reflecting renal function.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value for the estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR), typically reported in mL/min/1.73 m². If the value is preceded by an approximation symbol (e.g., ≈) or reported as 'estimated creatinine clearance' in the absence of a formal eGFR, extract the numeric value.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no numeric eGFR or estimated filtration rate is documented in the pretreatment record.
definition.name: estimated_glomerular_filtration_rate

definition.description: Presence of fluid collections outside the brain parenchyma but within the skull.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the pretreatment neuroimaging report (e.g., MRI or CT) identifies the presence or absence of extra-axial fluid collections, including subdural or epidural collections.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the report does not mention extra-axial fluid collections or the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: extra_axial_fluid_collection

definition.description: Presence of abnormal physical examination findings in the patient's extremities.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if the physical examination of the extremities (arms and legs) noted any abnormal findings, such as lesions, atrophy, or other pathology.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the extremity examination is not documented or if the results are ambiguous.
definition.name: extremity_exam_findings

definition.description: Presence of breast cancer in the patient's family history.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify whether the patient's medical record indicates a family history of breast cancer, typically found in the Family History section.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if family history is not documented or if there is no mention of breast cancer specifically.
definition.name: family_history_of_breast_cancer

definition.description: Whether the patient has a documented family history of colon cancer.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient's record, specifically within the Family History section, indicates a relative had colon cancer.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if family history is not mentioned or is explicitly documented as unknown.
definition.name: family_history_of_colon_cancer

definition.description: Presence of lung cancer in the patient's family history.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient's medical record indicates a family history of lung cancer. A value of 'Yes' is assigned if any relative (e.g., father, mother, sibling) is documented as having had lung cancer. A value of 'No' is assigned if the record explicitly states there is no family history of lung cancer.
definition.missing_value_rule: If family history is not mentioned, is not specifically addressed regarding lung cancer, or is documented as unknown, the value is represented as null.
definition.name: family_history_of_lung_cancer

definition.description: Presence of a family history of myocardial infarction
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether there is a documented history of myocardial infarction (MI) or heart attack in first-degree relatives (parents, siblings, or children) within the patient's family history records.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Unknown' if family history is not documented or explicitly stated as unknown.
definition.name: family_history_of_myocardial_infarction

definition.description: The severity of patient-reported fatigue, typically measured on a grade scale.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the severity grade of fatigue using the 0-4 scale (e.g., CTCAE or PRO-CTCAE). Map descriptive terms as follows: 'none' to 0, 'mild' to 1, 'moderate' to 2, 'severe' to 3, and 'life-threatening' or 'disabling' to 4. If only a continuous score from a different instrument is provided (e.g., 0-100 or 0-10) without an explicit grade, treat as null to avoid ad hoc formula invention.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if fatigue is not mentioned or if the reported value cannot be reliably mapped to the 0-4 ordinal scale.
definition.name: fatigue

definition.description: Presence of chemotherapy-induced febrile neutropenia in the patient's medical history.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient has a documented occurrence of febrile neutropenia, typically identified by explicit mention of the diagnosis, hospital admissions for febrile neutropenia, or treatment-related toxicity notes mentioning fever during neutropenia.
definition.missing_value_rule: If febrile neutropenia is not documented or explicitly denied, represent as 'Absent'.
definition.name: febrile_neutropenia_presence

definition.description: Presence of a focal lesion located within the brain parenchyma.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify from the radiology report whether focal intra-axial lesions are identified or noted as absent.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the report does not mention focal intra-axial lesions or the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: focal_intra_axial_lesion

definition.description: The presence or absence of gene amplification in a patient sample.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify whether the pretreatment record indicates the status of gene amplification (e.g., via FISH or NGS) as amplified or non-amplified/negative.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if gene amplification status is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: gene_amplification_status

definition.description: Presence or absence of a genetic mutation.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether a genetic mutation is reported as present (e.g., 'mutation', 'loss of [gene]', 'deletion mutation') or explicitly reported as absent/wild-type from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no information regarding genetic mutation status is documented.
definition.name: genetic_mutation_status

definition.description: The total amount of genomic DNA used as input for the molecular assay.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric quantity of genomic DNA input, reported in nanograms (ng), from the molecular pathology or laboratory report.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the DNA input amount is not documented or is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: genomic_dna_input_amount

definition.description: Qualitative appearance of the ocular globes on imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: From the orbits section of the radiology report, identify if the globes are described as within normal limits or unremarkable (Normal), or if any pathology, mass, or abnormal enhancement is noted (Abnormal).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the globes are not mentioned or the documentation is insufficient to determine status.
definition.name: globe_appearance

definition.description: The concentration of glucose in the blood.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value of the blood glucose level recorded in the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no glucose measurement is documented.
definition.name: glucose_level

definition.description: Patient use of growth factor support to mitigate or treat chemotherapy-induced neutropenia.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify whether the patient was prescribed or administered growth factor support (e.g., G-CSF, filgrastim, pegfilgrastim) as documented in the medications list, treatment plan, or clinical notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: If no mention of growth factor support is found in the record, represent as 'No'.
definition.name: growth_factor_support_use

definition.description: The patient's head shape and trauma status as documented during a physical examination.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the description of the head's shape and the presence or absence of trauma. A finding of 'normocephalic atraumatic' (or 'NC/AT') indicates a normal head shape and the absence of trauma.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the head shape and trauma status are not documented or are ambiguous.
definition.name: head_shape_and_trauma_status

definition.description: Patient's heart rate measured in beats per minute.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value of the heart rate (HR) from the vital signs section of the pretreatment clinical record.
definition.missing_value_rule: If heart rate is not documented or is recorded as ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: heart_rate

definition.description: The patient's height measurement
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value for height from the pretreatment record, typically found in the vital signs or physical examination section.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if height is not documented in the record.
definition.name: height

definition.description: The volume percentage of red blood cells in the blood.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value of the hematocrit measurement from the pretreatment laboratory records.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the hematocrit value is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: hematocrit

definition.description: The concentration of hemoglobin in the blood.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value for hemoglobin (Hgb) from the pretreatment complete blood count (CBC) result, reported in g/dL.
definition.missing_value_rule: If no numeric hemoglobin value is documented, represent as null.
definition.name: hemoglobin_level

definition.description: Presence of abnormal lymph node enlargement in the hilar region of the lungs.
definition.measurement_definition: Review radiology reports (specifically CT chest) and pathology reports for mentions of hilar lymphadenopathy. Extract 'Present' if the text describes 'hilar lymphadenopathy', 'ipsilateral hilar lymphadenopathy', or hilar nodes as 'enlarged' or 'suspicious'. Extract 'Absent' if the text states 'no hilar lymphadenopathy', 'hilar regions: no abnormal lymphadenopathy', or 'hilar lymph nodes are within normal size limits'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if hilar lymph nodes are not mentioned or if the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: hilar_lymphadenopathy_presence

definition.description: Whether the patient has a documented diagnosis of hyperlipidemia.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the presence of hyperlipidemia from the 'Past Medical History' or 'Comorbidities' sections of the patient record. The status is also considered 'Present' if the patient is prescribed a lipid-lowering medication, such as a statin (e.g., atorvastatin).
definition.missing_value_rule: If there is no mention of hyperlipidemia and no lipid-lowering medications are listed in the record, the value is represented as 'Absent'.
definition.name: hyperlipidemia_status

definition.description: Presence of hypothyroidism prior to the start of the current treatment line.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient has a diagnosis of hypothyroidism. This can be identified by an explicit diagnosis (e.g., 'hypothyroidism'), the use of thyroid hormone replacement therapy (e.g., levothyroxine), or laboratory results indicating hypothyroidism (e.g., elevated TSH).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Absent' if no mention of hypothyroidism, related medications, or relevant laboratory findings is found in the record.
definition.name: hypothyroidism_presence

definition.description: Qualitative assessment of FDG uptake in the cerebellar hemispheres from PET imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the reported level of FDG uptake in the cerebellum from the imaging report, identifying whether the uptake is normal, decreased (hypometabolism), or increased (hypermetabolism).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the cerebellar FDG uptake is not mentioned or the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: imaging_finding_cerebellar_fdg_uptake

definition.description: Presence of a mass in the right lower lobe of the lung as identified by imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the pretreatment imaging report (e.g., chest CT or X-ray) explicitly documents the presence of a mass located in the right lower lobe of the lung.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if imaging reports are unavailable or if the right lower lobe is not assessed/mentioned.
definition.name: imaging_finding_right_lower_lobe_mass

definition.description: Presence of a mass in the upper lobe of the lung on imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify from pretreatment imaging reports (e.g., CT, chest X-ray) if a mass is documented in the upper lobe of the lung.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if imaging reports are unavailable or if the report does not mention the upper lobe.
definition.name: imaging_finding_upper_lobe_mass

definition.description: Maximum Standardized Uptake Value (SUVmax) measured via PET imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the highest reported standardized uptake value (SUVmax) for the primary tumor or most metabolic lesion from the pretreatment PET scan.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no numeric SUVmax value is documented in the record.
definition.name: imaging_pet_suv_max

definition.description: The number of puffs of inhaler medication administered per dose.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value representing the number of inhaler puffs per administration from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no numeric dosage is documented.
definition.name: inhaler_usage_dosage

definition.description: Presence of bleeding within the cranial cavity.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether intracranial hemorrhage (including intraparenchymal, subdural, or epidural hemorrhage) is identified on brain imaging reports.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if imaging documentation is missing or does not explicitly evaluate for hemorrhage.
definition.name: intracranial_hemorrhage

definition.description: Presence of jugular venous distention on physical examination.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if jugular venous distention (JVD) is documented as present or absent in the pretreatment physical examination or clinical notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the documentation is absent or ambiguous.
definition.name: jugular_venous_distention_presence

definition.description: The percentage of tumor cell nuclei that are positive for the Ki-67 protein, representing the proliferative growth fraction of the tumor.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical percentage associated with Ki-67 (or MIB-1) from the immunohistochemistry (IHC) or pathology report. If the value is reported as an approximation (e.g., '~30%'), extract the number as a float.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the Ki-67 proliferation index is not documented or the documentation is too ambiguous to derive a numerical value.
definition.name: ki67_proliferation_index

definition.description: Presence of knee osteoarthritis at pretreatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if knee osteoarthritis is documented as a diagnosis in the patient's medical history, problem list, or clinical notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: If no mention of knee osteoarthritis is found in the patient record, the value is recorded as null.
definition.name: knee_osteoarthritis_presence

definition.description: The proportion of mutant KRAS G12C alleles relative to the total number of alleles at that locus, typically derived from next-generation sequencing.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the Variant Allele Frequency (VAF) specifically for the KRAS G12C mutation from molecular profiling or next-generation sequencing (NGS) reports. This is typically reported as a percentage.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the KRAS G12C mutation is not detected (wild-type), not tested, or if the VAF is not numerically specified.
definition.name: kras_g12c_variant_allele_frequency

definition.description: Serum lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) level.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value of the serum lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) measurement from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if LDH is not documented or the value is ambiguous.
definition.name: ldh_level

definition.description: The maximum linear dimension of the lesion.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value of the lesion's largest dimension in centimeters. If a range is provided, extract the upper limit.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent missing or ambiguous documentation as null.
definition.name: lesion_size

definition.description: The sequential order of the therapy regimen currently being administered or the most recent regimen attempted for the target condition.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the line of therapy designated in the pretreatment record (e.g., 'first line', 'second line', 'third-line').
definition.missing_value_rule: If the line of therapy is not documented or is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: line_of_therapy

definition.description: Whether the patient is receiving lipid-lowering therapy.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the presence of lipid-lowering medications (e.g., statins, fibrates, bile acid sequestrants, PCSK9 inhibitors) from the pretreatment medication list or clinical notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no mention of lipid-lowering medication use or a specific denial of such therapy.
definition.name: lipid_lowering_therapy_use

definition.description: Presence of metastatic disease in the liver.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether imaging reports (such as CT, MRI, or PET/CT) or pathology reports identify metastatic lesions in the liver or explicitly state the absence of liver metastases.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the liver is not mentioned or the presence/absence of metastasis is not documented in the record.
definition.name: liver_metastasis_presence

definition.description: The specific lobe of the lung that was surgically removed during a lobectomy procedure.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the lung lobe specified as being removed in the surgical history, radiology reports, or pathology reports (e.g., 'right lower lobectomy' maps to 'Right Lower Lobe').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no lobectomy is documented or if the specific lobe removed is not identified.
definition.name: lobectomy_type

definition.description: The histological subtype of the primary lung cancer.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the histological type of the lung cancer (e.g., adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, large-cell carcinoma) from pathology reports or diagnostic assessments. If only the broad category 'non-small cell lung cancer' (NSCLC) is specified without a subtype, extract that as the histology.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Unknown' if histology is not documented in the record.
definition.name: lung_cancer_histology

definition.description: The overall clinical or pathologic stage of the patient's lung cancer.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the overall stage of lung cancer as a Roman numeral. Map sub-stages I and IA/IB to 'I', and sub-stages IIA/IIB to 'II'. Extract IIIA, IIIB, and IV as specified.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the stage is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: lung_cancer_stage

definition.description: Presence of a medical diagnosis of lung disease.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient record contains a diagnosis of any lung-related disease (e.g., COPD, asthma, interstitial lung disease, etc.).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Absent' if no lung disease diagnosis is documented.
definition.name: lung_disease_diagnosis

definition.description: Maximum standardized uptake value (SUVmax) of the primary lung mass on PET/CT imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric SUVmax value specifically associated with the primary lung mass (e.g., right lower lobe lesion) from the PET/CT radiology report.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the SUVmax for the lung mass is not documented or is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: lung_mass_suvmax

definition.description: Whether lymph node dissection was conducted during the surgical procedure.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract from the operative report or pathology record whether lymph node dissection (LND) was performed.
definition.missing_value_rule: If documentation is absent or ambiguous, represent as 'Not Performed'.
definition.name: lymph_node_dissection_status

definition.description: The TNM M-stage indicating whether the cancer has metastasized to distant sites.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the M-stage value (e.g., M0 or M1) from the TNM staging description provided in the pretreatment clinical documentation.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the M-stage is not explicitly documented.
definition.name: m_stage

definition.description: Whether a mediastinal lymph node dissection was performed during the surgical procedure.
definition.measurement_definition: Search the operative report or surgical summary for explicit mention that a mediastinal lymph node dissection was performed.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the record contains no mention of mediastinal lymph node dissection or sampling, the value is null.
definition.name: mediastinal_lymph_node_dissection_performed

definition.description: Whether the patient is prescribed calcium carbonate medication.
definition.measurement_definition: Search the medication list and clinical history for 'calcium carbonate' or 'calcium supplement'. If either is documented, extract 'Yes'; otherwise, extract 'No'.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the medication list is absent or there is no mention of calcium carbonate or calcium supplements, represent as 'No'.
definition.name: medication_calcium_carbonate

definition.description: Patient exposure to the chemotherapy agent cisplatin.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient has received cisplatin (generic) or Platinol (brand name). This includes records of completed cycles, administration in the history of present illness, or listed chemotherapy regimens.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'No' if the medication is not mentioned or if there is no evidence of administration in the provided records.
definition.name: medication_cisplatin

definition.description: Patient's use of denosumab, a bone-modifying agent used for skeletal-related event prophylaxis.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient was prescribed or initiated on denosumab within the pretreatment records.
definition.missing_value_rule: If denosumab is not mentioned or no evidence of its use is documented, represent as 'No'.
definition.name: medication_denosumab

definition.description: Whether the patient has previously received pemetrexed (Alimta) chemotherapy.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient's medical record indicates the administration of pemetrexed or Alimta, often found in chemotherapy regimens (e.g., 'cis-Alimta', 'cisplatin-pemetrexed').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'No' if there is no mention of the medication in the record.
definition.name: medication_pemetrexed

definition.description: Presence of thickening of the meninges as identified on neuroimaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether meningeal thickening is reported as present or absent within the extra-axial structures or impression section of the pretreatment neuroimaging reports.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the report does not mention the meninges or if the status is described ambiguously.
definition.name: meningeal_thickening

definition.description: The amplification status of the MET gene in tumor tissue.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the MET amplification status from the molecular profiling or NGS report. Classify as 'Amplified' if the report indicates 'amplified', 'gain', or a high copy number; classify as 'Negative' if the report indicates 'not detected', 'wild-type', or no amplification.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if MET amplification status or copy number is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: met_amplification_status

definition.description: Patient-level assessment of whether there was a metabolic response to treatment, typically determined by functional imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the presence or absence of a documented metabolic response to therapy (e.g., via PET scan) from the pretreatment or treatment-monitoring records.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no information regarding metabolic response is documented.
definition.name: metabolic_response

definition.description: The anatomical location of metastatic disease in a patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify the anatomical sites of distant metastasis as documented in radiology reports (such as CT, MRI, or PET scans) or oncology assessment notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no metastatic locations are documented or if the patient is explicitly noted to have no distant metastases.
definition.name: metastasis_location

definition.description: Whether the patient was administered morphine prior to treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract 'Yes' if the patient record indicates the use or administration of morphine (e.g., for pain control); otherwise extract 'No'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if morphine administration is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: morphine_administered

definition.description: Microsatellite instability (MSI) status of the tumor.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the MSI status from the molecular pathology or Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) report. Values such as 'Stable', 'MSS', 'Microsatellite Stable' map to 'Stable'; values such as 'High', 'MSI-H', 'MSI-High' map to 'High'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if MSI status is not documented or the result is ambiguous.
definition.name: msi_status

definition.description: Presence of myelosuppression at pretreatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify whether myelosuppression is documented as present or absent in the pretreatment clinical record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if myelosuppression is not mentioned or documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: myelosuppression

definition.description: Napsin A expression as determined by immunohistochemical (IHC) staining of tumor cells.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the result of Napsin A immunohistochemistry from the pathology report.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if Napsin A staining was not performed or the result is not documented.
definition.name: napsin_a_expression

definition.description: The severity of nausea experienced by the patient, typically graded using the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) or Patient-Reported Outcomes version of CTCAE (PRO-CTCAE).
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric grade of nausea severity (1-4) from the patient record. If documented as a range (e.g., 'grade 1-2'), extract the maximum value of the range. Map descriptive terms to numeric grades: Mild = 1, Moderate = 2, Severe = 3, Life-threatening/Disabling = 4.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if nausea is not mentioned, is explicitly documented as absent, or if the severity is not specified.
definition.name: nausea_severity

definition.description: Presence of necrotic fluid in the clinical specimen or anatomical site.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify any mention of necrotic fluid in the patient's pretreatment records; categorize as 'Present' if identified as present or obvious, and 'Absent' otherwise.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Absent' if necrotic fluid is not mentioned or documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: necrotic_fluid_presence

definition.description: The ratio of the absolute neutrophil count to the absolute lymphocyte count, used as a marker of systemic inflammation.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the explicitly reported neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) from laboratory results. If the ratio is not explicitly provided but absolute neutrophil and lymphocyte counts are available in the CBC differential, the value is the quotient of absolute neutrophils divided by absolute lymphocytes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if neither the NLR nor both necessary components (absolute neutrophils and absolute lymphocytes) are documented.
definition.name: neutrophil_to_lymphocyte_ratio

definition.description: Presence of night sweats as a systemic symptom.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the pretreatment record documents the occurrence of night sweats or general sweats.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the documentation is absent or ambiguous.
definition.name: night_sweats

definition.description: The New York Heart Association (NYHA) functional classification of heart failure.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the reported NYHA class (I, II, III, or IV) from the patient's pretreatment clinical notes, typically associated with descriptions of dyspnea and exercise tolerance.
definition.missing_value_rule: Report as null if no NYHA class is documented or if the documentation is too ambiguous to assign a specific class.
definition.name: nyha_class

definition.description: The current clinical management phase of a patient under oncology care.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the stated status of oncology management from the pretreatment record, identifying whether the patient is undergoing active treatment, is in a routine follow-up or surveillance phase, or is not under oncology management.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent absent or ambiguous documentation as 'Unknown'.
definition.name: oncology_management_status

definition.description: Presence of abnormal contrast enhancement of the optic chiasm on MRI.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the post-contrast T1-weighted imaging report indicates the presence or absence of abnormal enhancement of the optic chiasm.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the optic chiasm is not mentioned or the documentation regarding its enhancement is ambiguous.
definition.name: optic_chiasm_enhancement

definition.description: The presence or absence of organ enlargement (organomegaly) in the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether organomegaly is documented as present or absent from the pretreatment clinical records, including radiology reports and physical examination notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if organomegaly is not mentioned in the documentation.
definition.name: organomegaly_presence

definition.description: The percentage of hemoglobin saturated with oxygen (SpO2).
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical percentage value of oxygen saturation (SpO2) from the vital signs section of the record. If the value is reported with modifiers such as 'RA' (room air) or a specific flow rate of supplemental oxygen, extract only the numeric percentage.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if oxygen saturation is not documented or if the value is ambiguous.
definition.name: oxygen_saturation

definition.description: The immunohistochemical expression status of the p40 protein in tumor cells.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the result of p40 immunohistochemistry (IHC) staining from the pathology report. Categorize as 'Positive' if the report indicates any form of positivity (e.g., 'Positive', 'Strong nuclear positivity', 'p40+', 'Diffuse nuclear') and 'Negative' if the report indicates negativity (e.g., 'Negative', 'p40-', 'Excludes squamous differentiation').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if p40 immunohistochemistry is not performed or the result is not mentioned in the record.
definition.name: p40_expression

definition.description: Patient's status regarding the receipt or designation of palliative care.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the pretreatment record indicates the patient is receiving palliative care, has a palliative care consultation, or is documented as having a palliative care status.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no mention of palliative care status in the record.
definition.name: palliative_care_status

definition.description: Whether the patient has expressed or documented specific medical treatment preferences or advance directives in the pretreatment record.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the record contains any mention of advance directives, living wills, DNR (Do Not Resuscitate) orders, DNI (Do Not Intubate) orders, or explicitly stated patient preferences regarding medical care.
definition.missing_value_rule: If no documentation of patient wishes is present in the record, represent as 'Not Documented'.
definition.name: patient_wishes

definition.description: The numeric dose of pembrolizumab administered to the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value of the pembrolizumab dose administered per dose cycle from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no numeric dose is documented or if the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: pembrolizumab_dose

definition.description: The grade of peripheral neuropathy, representing the severity of nerve damage often induced by chemotherapy.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical grade of peripheral neuropathy (e.g., 'Grade 1', '2/4') from the oncology assessment, progress notes, or patient-reported outcome tools such as PRO-CTCAE. If only a descriptive term is provided (e.g., 'Mild', 'Moderate', 'Severe') and mapped to a grade in the same note, extract the numeric grade.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent missing, not mentioned, or ambiguous grade documentation as null.
definition.name: peripheral_neuropathy_grade

definition.description: Presence of edema surrounding the tumor as identified on radiographic imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the pretreatment imaging records explicitly state the presence or absence of peritumoral (surrounding) edema.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if edema is not mentioned or if the documentation is too ambiguous to determine presence or absence.
definition.name: peritumoral_edema

definition.description: Presence of abnormal signal intensity in the white matter surrounding the cerebral ventricles on neuroimaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the presence or absence of 'periventricular signal abnormality' or 'periventricular white matter signal changes' from the radiology findings or impression.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the radiology report does not mention periventricular signal intensity or if the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: periventricular_signal_abnormality

definition.description: Presence of PI3K pathway activation, typically identified through molecular profiling of the PIK3CA gene.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the status of PI3K pathway activation from molecular pathology or Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) reports. The feature is 'Activated' if the report identifies activating mutations in PIK3CA (e.g., H1047R, E545K) or explicitly states 'PI3K pathway activation'. The feature is 'Not Activated' if the report explicitly states that no activating PIK3CA mutations were detected or that the pathway is not activated.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the PI3K pathway status is not documented or the report is ambiguous.
definition.name: pi3k_pathway_activation

definition.description: the number of platelets per microliter of blood, reported in thousands (k/uL)
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value for platelets (Plt) from the Complete Blood Count (CBC) in the pretreatment record. Report the value in thousands per microliter (k/uL); for example, if the value is 210,000/uL, extract 210.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the platelet count is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: platelet_count

definition.description: The presence and qualitative volume of fluid accumulation in the pleural space.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the descriptive status of pleural effusion from the most recent imaging reports (e.g., CT, PET/CT, Chest X-ray) or clinical notes. Map 'no pleural effusion' or 'none' to 'Absent', and qualitative descriptors such as 'small', 'moderate', or 'large' to their respective categories.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no mention of pleural effusion or if the documentation is too ambiguous to categorize.
definition.name: pleural_effusion

definition.description: Indicates whether the patient has a diagnosis of pneumonia.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify the presence of a pneumonia diagnosis, including mentions of 'pneumonia', 'community acquired pneumonia', or the ICD-10 code J18, within the patient record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Absent' if no mention of a pneumonia diagnosis is found in the clinical documentation.
definition.name: pneumonia_diagnosis

definition.description: Presence of abnormal contrast enhancement in the posterior fossa.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether abnormal contrast enhancement is identified in the posterior fossa (including the cerebellar hemispheres and brainstem) from post-contrast T1-weighted imaging reports.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the posterior fossa is not mentioned, if contrast was not administered, or if the report is ambiguous regarding enhancement in this region.
definition.name: posterior_fossa_enhancement

definition.description: Indication of whether the patient has a history of radiation therapy prior to the current clinical assessment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient has received any form of radiation therapy (e.g., palliative thoracic radiation, whole-brain radiation, stereotactic radiosurgery/SRS, external beam radiation therapy/EBRT) from the patient's past medical history, oncology consultation notes, or review of systems.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the medical record is silent on radiation therapy or is ambiguous; represent as 'No' if previous radiation therapy is explicitly denied.
definition.name: previous_radiation_therapy

definition.description: The anatomical location of the primary lung tumor.
definition.measurement_definition: The specific lobe of the lung where the primary tumor is located, extracted from radiology reports (e.g., CT, PET/CT) or surgical/biopsy pathology reports.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Unspecified' if the lobe is not documented or the location is ambiguous.
definition.name: primary_tumor_location

definition.description: The greatest dimension of the primary lung tumor.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the maximum diameter of the primary lung tumor from the pretreatment record, typically found in radiology reports (CT, PET/CT) or surgical pathology reports, measured in centimeters.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no numeric tumor size is documented or if the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: primary_tumor_size

definition.description: Whether the patient has a history of receiving platinum-based chemotherapy prior to the current treatment context.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient has received chemotherapy containing a platinum agent (e.g., cisplatin, carboplatin, oxaliplatin) from the past medical history, oncology progress notes, or discharge summaries.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the record does not mention chemotherapy or the specific agents used.
definition.name: prior_platinum_chemotherapy

definition.description: Presence of symptoms triggered by physical exertion that have worsened in frequency or severity over time.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient record indicates symptoms (e.g., dyspnea, angina, or fatigue) that occur during exertion and are described as progressive or worsening.
